transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what brings you in today?

Hi, thank you for having me. Um, I hope I'm not wasting your time, I really appreciate you seeing me. 

I guess I'm here because things have been just a little... stressful at work lately. I drive for a living, and, well... dispatch and compliance have been tracking my route changes. They use the computer system to do it, and I've been hearing these little comments on the radio. 

I know when I say it out loud it might sound silly, and people keep telling me it’s just normal oversight. I really try to believe them, I do, because I want to be a good employee. But... I can just tell that certain drivers are reporting on me. I don't want to sound difficult or paranoid or anything, I promise I'm a hard worker. Does that make sense? I hope I'm explaining it okay.
When you say you can tell certain drivers are reporting on you, do you mean you believe they are actively giving information about you to dispatch, even if they haven’t directly told you that?

Um... yes, exactly. I mean, I really don't want to accuse anyone of anything malicious, because I know everyone is just trying to do their jobs. But... yes. 

It’s just that the computer system tracks every little route change I make, which, I know, they say is just normal oversight. I really try to tell myself that. But then I hear those little comments on the dispatch radio, and... well, I can just tell that certain drivers are actively feeding them information about me. Even if they don't say it to my face, the things they say on the radio make it obvious they're reporting on me. 

I'm sorry, I know exactly how that sounds. Does that make me sound crazy? I really don't want to be a problem for anyone there or make a big deal out of nothing, I just... I can just tell it's happening. Am I explaining that alright?
Do you believe that the company or certain drivers are specifically targeting you or plotting against you in any way beyond just reporting your route changes?

Oh, um... no, no, I don't think so. I really don't want to make it sound like there's some big conspiracy or that they're out to get me. I'm sure they're mostly good people, you know? 

I don't think they're plotting to ruin my life or anything like that... at least, I haven't noticed anything beyond the route tracking and those radio comments. I really hope I didn't make them sound awful just now. I always try to get along with everyone at the depot, and I'd hate to be the kind of person who thinks everyone is maliciously out to get them. It's really just the reporting thing that bothers me. 

Is it okay that I just feel a little weird about that part? I promise I'm not trying to be dramatic or make a mountain out of a molehill.

Have you ever felt that certain things people say or do have a special meaning that only you understand, or that events happening around you are specifically directed at you in a way others don't seem to notice?

Um... no, I don't think so. Like, special hidden meanings? No, I really don't think I've ever felt anything like that. I always try to just take things at face value, you know? I'd hate to be the kind of person who reads into every little thing or thinks the whole world revolves around them. 

It's really just the stuff at work with the dispatch radio that I mentioned before... but outside of that, no, I don't notice anything having a secret message or being directed at me. I hope I'm understanding your question right? I just want to make sure I'm giving you the right information, I don't want to be confusing. Did that answer what you were asking?
Have you ever felt like things people say or do in your personal life, outside of work, have a special meaning that only you understand, or that they are directed at you in a way others don’t see?

Oh, I see... um, no, definitely not. Not in my personal life at all. I really try to keep things normal at home, you know? I don't want you to think I'm sitting around analyzing what my friends or family are doing, or looking for hidden messages with them. They're wonderful, and I always just trust what they tell me. 

It's really just... just that specific thing at the depot that I mentioned. I hope I didn't make it sound like I'm suspicious of everyone everywhere... I'd hate for you to think I'm like that. I try really hard to be easygoing outside of work. Is it okay that it's just a work thing? I promise I'm not reading into things my friends say or anything like that.
Have you ever had thoughts that others around you have not been able to understand, or beliefs that you know are unusual but you still feel certain about, even when others say they aren't true?

Um... well, I guess... maybe just the thing at work I was mentioning? I really hate to sound like I'm being stubborn, because I always try to listen to other people's perspectives and I don't want to be difficult. 

But... with the dispatch and compliance stuff, you know, tracking my route changes through the computer system and those little comments on the radio? When I've brought it up, people tell me it's just normal oversight. They say it's just standard procedure and that it's nothing. But... I can just tell that certain drivers are reporting on me. I just know it, even when people tell me it isn't true. 

I really hope that doesn't make me sound unreasonable or like I'm ignoring what people tell me. I just can't seem to shake the feeling that I'm right about this one specific thing. Does that make sense? I'm just trying to answer your question as honestly as I can, I hope that's okay.

Can you tell me more about why you feel certain that certain drivers are reporting on you, even when others say it isn't true? Do you feel completely sure that this is happening, even though no one else seems to notice it?

Um... well, it's just... I really don't want to sound like I'm complaining about my coworkers, because most of them are really great, and I try to get along with everyone. I hate office drama, you know? 

But... it's the computer system in the trucks. Every time I have to make a slight route change, even if it's just for traffic, it gets logged. And then... then I hear these little comments on the dispatch radio. They sound like jokes or just normal chatter, but I know they're about where I just was. And when I try to ask about it, they just brush it off and say it's normal compliance oversight. 

But I can just tell. I know certain drivers are reporting on me to dispatch. I know it sounds a little silly when I say it out loud, and I'm really sorry if it makes me seem paranoid or something. I try to ignore it, I really do. But I'm just... I'm completely sure it's happening, even if they won't admit it. Is it bad that I feel that way? I just want to do my job well and not cause any trouble.
Outside of your concerns at work, have you ever had any beliefs that are very different from those around you, or thoughts that others say don’t make sense, but you still feel certain are true?

Oh, no, definitely not. Um, outside of work, I really try to just be normal, you know? I don't have any strange ideas or anything that people would think is weird. I try so hard to just blend in and be a good friend and family member. 

I'd hate for you to think I'm just walking around with all these... unusual thoughts all the time. It really is just that one specific thing with the dispatch and the other drivers. I know I probably sounded a bit intense talking about it, and I'm really sorry if I did. But at home, or with my friends, we all pretty much see things the same way. I wouldn't want to make anyone uncomfortable by having beliefs that don't make sense to them. I hope it's okay that it's just the work thing? I promise I'm very agreeable outside of that.
